definitions.explanation: The logographic characters adopted from Chinese and used in Japanese writing.

examples.japanese: {漢字|かんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{漢字|かんじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know how to read this kanji.

examples.japanese: {漢字|かんじ}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look it up in a kanji dictionary.

notes:
{漢字|かんじ} refers to Chinese characters used in Japanese writing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {漢字|かんじ}を{書|か}く (to write kanji)
- {漢字|かんじ}を{読|よ}む (to read kanji)
- {漢字|かんじ}{辞典|じてん} (kanji dictionary)
- {常用|じょうよう}{漢字|かんじ} (joyo kanji, the official list of commonly used kanji)

Note: Japanese writing uses three scripts: {漢字|かんじ} (kanji), {平仮名|ひらがな} (hiragana), and {片仮名|かたかな} (katakana).
